summary.en: Create nodes, follow their next links and insert at either end of a chain.
summary.bn: নোড বানাও, next লিংক ধরে এগোও, আর লিস্টের দুই প্রান্তে insert করো।

notes: These implementations use C17. Compound literals and declarations in loop headers date from C99; C17 does not add automatic memory management.

examples.title: Insert a new head or tail
examples.explanationHtml: Mode 0 links the new node to the old head before publishing it. Mode 1 walks to the last next field and attaches the node.

examples.title: Create and print an empty sequence
examples.explanationHtml: No node exists when the input count is zero. Both printing and destruction stop immediately at NULL.

examples.title: Track a tail for repeated appends
examples.explanationHtml: A stored tail removes the traversal needed by append. The first insertion must set head as well as tail.

practice.title: Build a sequence from input
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), then n values (-99..99). Print List: and all nodes in insertion order.

practice.title: Build in reverse reading order
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), then n values (-99..99). Prepend each value while reading and print List:.
hints: Each new head precedes every earlier input.

practice.title: Append a final mark
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), then n values (-99..99). Read one additional value (-99..99), append it and print List:.
hints: The empty list’s head field is the first available link.

practice.title: Concatenate disjoint chains
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), then n values (-99..99). Read a second count and values with the same bounds. Join both chains and print List:.
hints: Transfer the second chain to the first chain’s final link.

quiz.prompt: In a nonempty ordinary singly linked list, what does the final next contain?
quiz.explanation: NULL terminates the chain. A link back to head would create a circular list.

quiz.prompt: Which prepend assignment must happen first?
options: head = node followed by node->next = head
quiz.explanation: Preserve the old head before replacing it. Otherwise the old chain may become unreachable.

quiz.prompt: Without a tail pointer, what is the general cost of appending to n nodes?
quiz.explanation: The code must follow next until it locates the final NULL field.

quiz.prompt: When the first node is added to an empty list with both endpoints, what changes?
options: Both head and tail become the new node
quiz.explanation: A singleton is both first and last. Leaving head NULL would hide the newly added node.

quiz.prompt: What does a list traversal move to after reading cur->value?
quiz.explanation: The stored link determines order; separate allocations need not sit beside each other.

quiz.prompt: What happens to existing node addresses after prepending?
options: Every old node shifts right in memory
The allocator copies the entire chain
quiz.explanation: Only a new allocation and the head relationship change. Existing objects are not relocated.

quiz.prompt: Which boundary should printing handle before dereferencing cur?
options: The first value must be positive
There must be at least two nodes
Tail must point back to head
quiz.explanation: The loop condition guards the dereference and naturally allows an empty list.

quiz.prompt: Which value appears first after linking a new head?
quiz.explanation: The new head contains 72 and its next identifies the old node containing 85.

quiz.prompt: How many nodes are reachable in a two-link chain?
quiz.explanation: The traversal counts a and then b, stopping at b.next=NULL. There are two nodes, not two edges after head.

quiz.prompt: What does an empty chain contribute to traversal count?
quiz.explanation: The condition is false for a NULL head, so count remains zero and no value is read.

keyPoints.en: A singly linked node contains a value and one next link.
keyPoints.bn: সিঙ্গলি লিংকড নোডে একটি মান আর একটি next লিংক থাকে।

keyPoints.en: NULL marks the end of an ordinary singly linked chain.
keyPoints.bn: সাধারণ সিঙ্গলি লিংকড লিস্টের শেষ বোঝাতে NULL থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Prepending connects the new node before changing head.
keyPoints.bn: Prepend-এ আগে নতুন নোড জুড়বে, তারপর head বদলাবে।

keyPoints.en: A tail pointer makes repeated tail attachment constant time.
keyPoints.bn: Tail পয়েন্টার রাখলে বারবার শেষে যোগ করতে ধ্রুব সময় লাগে।

keyPoints.en: Each successfully allocated list node needs one eventual free.
keyPoints.bn: লিস্টের প্রতিটি বরাদ্দ করা নোড পরে একবার free করতে হবে।

examQuestions.question: Draw head insertion of 64 into head -> 72 -> 85 -> NULL.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Allocate N with value 64. First set N.next to the old head. Then set head to N. The result is head -> 64 -> 72 -> 85 -> NULL. Neither old value changes.

examQuestions.question: Write a prepend function returning success, including allocation failure.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
int prepend(Node **head, int value)
{
    Node *node = malloc(sizeof *node);
    if (node == NULL) {
        return 0;
    }
    *node = (Node){value, *head};
    *head = node;
    return 1;
}

examQuestions.question: Compare head insertion and tail insertion with and without a stored tail.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Head insertion changes a fixed number of links and takes O(1). Tail insertion without tail scans n nodes, so it takes O(n). With tail it takes O(1), but insertion into an empty list must update both endpoints.
